COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
C528 No.1089 of 2025
HON’BLE ASHISH NAITHANI, J.
Mr. Reituparna Joshi, learned counsel for the
Applicant.
2. Mr. Rakesh Negi, learned Brief Holder, for the State of 
Uttarakhand/1. 
3. In the present C528 Application filed under Bhartiya 
Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the Applicant has put a 
challenge to the entire proceedings of Criminal Miscellaneous 
Case No.178 of 2024, “Smt. Nikki Chaudhary Vs. Ashu @ 
Ashish” under Sections 376 and 506 of IPC, which is pending 
before the court of learned 1st Chief Judicial Magistrate, 
Roorkee, Haridwar. 
4. Admit.
5. Considering the submissions advanced by the learned 
counsel on behalf of the Applicant, an interference is being 
called for in the matter.
6. Issue notice to the respondent no.2. Steps to be taken 
within a week. Counter affidavit to be filed within a period of 
three weeks.
7. Till the next date of listing, the entire proceedings of 
Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.178 of 2024, “Smt. Nikki 
Chaudhary Vs. Ashu @ Ashish” under Sections 376 and 506 
of IPC, which is pending before the court of learned 1st Chief  Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee, Haridwar, shall remain stayed.
8. List this matter on 03.09.2025.
9. Stay application (IA No.1 of 2025) stands disposed of.
(ASHISH NAITHANI, J.)
 11.07.2025
Nitesh/
